segments.name: Aeronautics Systems
products: tactical fighter and air dominance aircraft
airborne battle management and command and control systems
segments.description: Designs, develops, produces and sustains military aircraft systems, including strike, fighter and uncrewed aircraft, for U.S. and international military customers.
segments.evidence: Aeronautics Systems is a leader in the design, development, production, integration, sustainment and modernization of military aircraft systems for the U.S. Air Force, the U.S. Navy, other U.S. government agencies, and international customers.

segments.name: Defense Systems
products: integrated, all-domain command and control (C2) systems
segments.description: Supplies strategic deterrent systems, advanced tactical weapons and missile defense solutions to the U.S. military and a broad range of international customers.
segments.evidence: Defense Systems is a leader in the design, engineering, development, integration and production of strategic deterrent systems, advanced tactical weapons, and missile defense solutions for the U.S. military and a broad range of international customers.

segments.name: Mission Systems
segments.description: Provides radar, sensors, electronic warfare, communications and cyber mission solutions primarily to the U.S. defense and intelligence community and international customers.
segments.evidence: Mission Systems is a leader in advanced mission solutions and multifunction systems, primarily for the U.S. defense and intelligence community, and international customers.

segments.name: Space Systems
products: satellites and spacecraft systems, subsystems, sensors and payloads
launch vehicles and related propulsion systems
segments.description: Delivers space, missile defense and launch systems, satellites, sensors and ground systems for national security, civil government, commercial and international customers.
segments.evidence: Space Systems is a leader in delivering end-to-end mission solutions through the design, development, integration, production and operation of space, missile defense, and launch systems for national security, civil government, commercial and international customers.

revenueModel.text: U.S. government defense and intelligence customers, chiefly the Department of War, pay for military aircraft, weapons, sensors and space systems on contracted programs.
revenueModel.evidence: We deliver a broad range of products, services and solutions to U.S. and international customers, and principally to the U.S. Department of War

changes.text: In 2025 the company moved the Strike and Surveillance Aircraft Solutions business unit from Defense Systems to Aeronautics Systems.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, the company realigned the Strike and Surveillance Aircraft Solutions (SSAS) business unit from Defense Systems to Aeronautics Systems.
